cases.query: the full list of event names that hooks are allowed to target when someone registers one
cases.why: hooks.py:22 HOOKS = ['response'] is the module-level list of valid hook event names; 'hooks' hints function/method but the gold is a plain variable.

cases.query: how per-request environment settings like proxies and SSL verification get merged with session-level defaults before a request is sent
cases.why: sessions.py:831 Session.merge_environment_settings() merges env proxies/verify/cert into the send kwargs; 'settings' hints variable but the gold is a method.

cases.query: the fixed set of HTTP status code types that requests automatically follows as redirects without extra handling
cases.why: models.py:95 REDIRECT_STATI is a tuple constant of the redirect-eligible status codes; 'types' hints class but the gold is a variable.

cases.query: how requests decides whether to strip a request body's Authorization header when following a redirect to a different host, keeping it only for same-host hops
cases.why: sessions.py:154 should_strip_auth compares hostnames (with an http->https same-port exception) to decide whether to drop the Authorization header on redirect.

cases.query: how the next redirect location gets pulled out of a response's headers before the session follows it further
cases.why: sessions.py:134 get_redirect_target reads resp.headers['location'] (re-encoding latin1->utf8) and returns the redirect URI or None.

cases.query: how requests works out the total size of a request body that could be a plain string, a file-like object, or a buffer, without fully reading it
cases.why: utils.py:160 super_len() inspects __len__, .len, or fstat on file descriptors to compute body size for Content-Length.

cases.query: the trick requests uses to write a file to disk safely so a crash midway won't leave a corrupted partial file in its place
cases.why: utils.py:329 atomic_open() writes to a temp file via mkstemp and os.replace()s it into place, removing the temp file on failure.

cases.query: how a target URL gets checked against the NO_PROXY environment list to decide whether proxying should be skipped entirely
cases.why: utils.py:810 should_bypass_proxies() checks no_proxy/NO_PROXY env vars (and localhost/netloc rules) to decide whether to skip proxying a URL.

cases.query: the function that re-quotes a URI so illegal characters get percent-encoded while already-escaped sequences are preserved
cases.why: utils.py:704 requote_uri() runs an unquote/quote cycle so the URI is fully and consistently percent-encoded.

cases.query: the class that stores HTTP response headers in a way that treats header names case-insensitively
cases.why: structures.py:20 CaseInsensitiveDict is a MutableMapping that preserves original key case but compares/looks up keys case-insensitively; used for headers.

cases.query: the method that walks a chain of redirect responses and yields each intermediate response or request as the session follows them
cases.why: sessions.py:186 resolve_redirects() is a generator that loops while resp.is_redirect, yielding Responses (or Requests when yield_requests=True) for each hop.

cases.query: the function that prepends a URL scheme like http when the given URL doesn't already specify one
cases.why: utils.py:1040 prepend_scheme_if_needed() parses the URL and prepends the given scheme only if one isn't already present, without replacing an existing scheme.
